purpose: Evidence packet and interaction preprocessing for three original web presets; this does not author the catalog, implement a product, or certify conformance.

candidate_token_calculations.method: WCAG relative luminance from sRGB literal hex foreground/background inputs; selected inputs and outputs recorded in contrast_check.py and contrast_results.json.
candidate_token_calculations.caveat: Ratios are candidate text-pair calculations, not rendered conformance. Focus ratios are descriptive calculations, not a sourced focus-indicator contrast requirement.

proposals.task: Review many records, filter/scan a queue, inspect one selected record, and commit a decision while handling stale or conflicting state.
proposals.platform: Desktop responsive web with a narrow web fallback.

observed_vs_inferred.observed: Sources establish color is not the only cue, candidate text contrast thresholds, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion preference semantics, and native modal dialog behaviors.
observed_vs_inferred.inferred: Queue + filter + selected-record split layout, region order, responsive list-to-record fallback, semantic tokens, and product states. No review console flow or screen was observed.

region_attention_map: Selected record detail and decision/activity controls
proposals.layout_hypothesis: Use a split queue/detail view only at wide widths; on narrow screens switch to a list-to-record route so columns do not become clipped. Breakpoints are unmeasured.

token_pairs.additional_cue: Label or icon; do not signal selection by hue alone.
Persistent visible outline; exact treatment remains a hypothesis.

component_states.loading: Static placeholder rows with textual loading status.
empty: No matching results with clear-filters route
component_states.error: Fetch failure preserves filters and offers Retry.
component_states.conflict: Show local and server versions with explicit compare/keep/replace actions; preserve unsent work where product behavior allows.
component_states.success: Decision saved text plus icon/status, not color alone.

proposals.keyboard_focus: Proposed visible persistent focus and sequence: filters -> queue -> selected record -> decision controls. Native modal is a candidate only for blocking conflict/irreversible confirmation; set deliberate initial focus, explicit buttons and Esc dismissal; test focus return.
proposals.reduced_motion: No motion is required. If a transition is used, the reduced-motion branch replaces slide/pan with a static state update and preserves status and focus.
proposals.alternative_and_rationale: A full-page record route is simpler but may cost context switching. A split view is a wide-screen task hypothesis; narrow screens route to the record to protect legibility.
verification_hypotheses: Keyboard-only traversal through loading, populated, empty and conflict states.
Measure rendered text pairs and confirm label/icon cues.
Test 1280, intermediate and 320 CSS px widths for clipping and return path; these are test points, not sourced breakpoints.
With OS reduced motion enabled, confirm state changes do not depend on movement.
Check Esc close and focus restoration in supported browsers.
limits: No product schema, workflow, queue data, or user test evidence.
Sources do not prove split-view effectiveness, row density, breakpoints, keyboard order, persistence semantics, or target conformance.

proposals.task: Count assigned inventory items on a phone and preserve or resolve count state during validation and sync.
proposals.platform: Phone web; Android app/WebView edge-to-edge behavior applies only if that host is used.

observed_vs_inferred.observed: Sources establish semantic color redundancy, contrast thresholds, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion preference, modal-dialog basics, and Android system-inset concerns.
observed_vs_inferred.inferred: One-column item/count sequence, in-flow actions, offline/sync/conflict states, and phone layout. No inventory flow or phone screen was observed.

region_attention_map: Save/Next action and text sync status
proposals.layout_hypothesis: One column; allow scroll around the virtual keyboard. In an edge-to-edge Android app/WebView, keep content and controls clear of bars, cutouts and gesture insets using host-appropriate inset behavior.

component_states.loading: Static item placeholder/label and text status.
component_states.empty: No assigned item with a clear next route.
component_states.invalid: Field-associated validation text and preserved input.
component_states.saving: Prevent duplicate submit while exposing a textual saving state.
component_states.offline: Report saved locally/waiting to sync only if product persistence is actually implemented.
component_states.conflict: Present server and local counts and explicit resolution options.
component_states.success: Textual saved/complete state plus check icon.

proposals.keyboard_focus: Proposed tab order: item context -> count -> note/exception -> Save/Next. Keep labels visible and focus indicator distinct; a conflict dialog needs a cancel route and should use the native modal pattern only if resolution blocks other work.
proposals.reduced_motion: State updates work without motion. With preference enabled, suppress spinner sweeps and count transitions while keeping a textual saving/sync state; no large scale/pan effects.
proposals.alternative_and_rationale: A fixed bottom action might improve reach but can be obscured by the IME or system/gesture inset. Begin with an in-flow action; adopt fixed positioning only after device tests establish that it remains visible and unobscured.
verification_hypotheses: Test supported Android edge-to-edge host, gesture navigation, system bars/cutouts, and IME open.
Test zoom/text scaling, invalid count, repeat submit, offline/reconnect and stale server count.
Test actual browser and physical phone; Android guidance does not establish ordinary mobile browser behavior.
Check rendered status/error/action text, keyboard and screen-reader interaction.
limits: Offline persistence, scanner, gloves, outdoor glare, units, input method and conflict semantics are unknown.
Android source does not define web breakpoints or touch target sizes.
No specific phone UI or task flow was observed.

proposals.task: Read a long document, navigate its sections, create annotations, and handle saved or conflicting note edits.
proposals.platform: Responsive web across desktop and narrow phone widths.

observed_vs_inferred.observed: Sources establish text contrast guidance, non-color cues, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion preference behavior and dialog focus/close behavior.
observed_vs_inferred.inferred: Warm reading canvas, reading-column hierarchy, collapsible contents, annotation and conflict flow. No reader screen or annotation workflow was observed.

proposals.layout_hypothesis: Collapse contents navigation on narrow screens and keep document text dominant. Column width, type scale, stickiness and pagination require real document/device evaluation.

token_pairs.additional_cue: Icon/underline or explicit comment label, not highlight hue alone.

component_states.empty: Explain absent content and preserve Back/return path.
component_states.error: Retry without losing the return path.
component_states.draft: Composer distinguishes an unsaved annotation from a saved note.
component_states.conflict: Show local and server note text with explicit resolve/keep/discard actions.
component_states.delete_or_exit: If confirmation is needed, offer clear cancel and confirm controls in an accessible dialog candidate.

proposals.keyboard_focus: Visible focus for contents links, search, annotation controls and dialog buttons. Keep a coherent document-control/annotation tab path, avoid traps, and test reading order with screen readers. Dialog uses deliberate focus, explicit close/cancel and Esc behavior when modal.
proposals.reduced_motion: No auto-pan/parallax is needed. When reduced motion is enabled, heading/annotation navigation reaches the same destination without smooth animated travel; test scroll and focus together.
proposals.alternative_and_rationale: Sticky contents can aid orientation but consume space and may obscure content under zoom. Start collapsible and non-sticky; add stickiness only if long-document testing shows a benefit.
verification_hypotheses: Test short/long docs, narrow view and browser zoom.
Test keyboard-only navigation and reading order with screen reader.
Test empty, load error, draft, conflict and delete/exit states.
Check actual text pairs and reduced-motion navigation/focus behavior.
limits: Typography scale, ideal line length, scroll model, annotation semantics and mobile pagination are not sourced.
No claim about successful task performance or product conformance.

alternatives_and_adoption.adopted_direction: Original, semantically named palette and task-state hypotheses grounded in primary accessibility/platform guidance; no third-party design material adopted.

alternatives.alternative: Always use a full-page selected record.
alternatives.candidate_choice: Split queue/detail at wide widths, full-page route when narrow; requires testing.
In-flow action first because IME/system inset overlap is unresolved; test reachability.
Collapsible, non-sticky navigation until zoom and long-document tests establish fit.
No individual item/revision or reuse terms checked; observation-only and original token suggestions.

open_questions: What exact fields and comparison needs drive review-queue scanning?
Must stock counts work offline, use scanners, support gloves or work in outdoor glare?
Does the reader need collaboration, simultaneous notes or mobile pagination?
Which browsers, Android host modes, viewport sizes, zoom levels and assistive technologies are supported?
What are the product's brand palette, typography and persistence/conflict rules?
